name: Nutrition Basics
overview: Understand nutrients, servings and balanced eating principles.
practice: Consult official dietary recommendations appropriate to age.

name: Calories & Energy
overview: Learn energy balance and how intake estimates work.
practice: Remember labels and activity estimates have uncertainty.

name: BMI Calculator
overview: Understand the body mass index screening formula.
practice: Do not diagnose health conditions from BMI alone.

name: Protein Intake
overview: Explore protein roles and intake considerations.
practice: Recognize that medical conditions may change requirements.

name: Hydration
overview: Understand fluid needs, activity and heat exposure.
practice: Follow clinician advice where fluid intake is medically restricted.

name: Food Labels
overview: Learn how to compare serving sizes and ingredient information.
practice: Check added sugars, sodium and allergen disclosures.

name: Walking & Cardio
overview: Understand aerobic activity intensity and progression.
practice: Adjust activity gradually to individual ability.

name: Strength Training
overview: Learn resistance exercise patterns and recovery.
practice: Use safe technique and appropriate progression.

name: Flexibility & Mobility
overview: Explore practical range-of-motion concepts.
practice: Avoid forcing painful movement or unsupported claims.

name: Fitness Metrics
overview: Understand pace, heart rate and training load estimates.
practice: Treat consumer wearables as estimates, not diagnosis.

name: Weight Management
overview: Explore sustainable habits and long-term progress metrics.
practice: Avoid extreme weight-loss plans and medical claims.

name: Workout Planning
overview: Understand training frequency, rest and habit formation.
practice: Match sessions to fitness level and health conditions.

name: Sleep Basics
overview: Learn sleep duration, routines and environmental factors.
practice: Seek clinical support for persistent sleep problems.

name: Stress Management
overview: Understand evidence-informed coping skills and planning.
practice: Recognize when professional mental health support is needed.

name: Mindfulness
overview: Explore attention exercises and realistic expectations.
practice: Do not replace required treatment with wellness exercises.

name: Digital Wellbeing
overview: Review screen habits, breaks and boundaries.
practice: Measure sleep impact and daytime functioning.

name: Healthy Habits
overview: Build repeatable routines around food, movement and rest.
practice: Choose measurable, achievable habits over rapid promises.

name: Mental Health Literacy
overview: Understand common terms and when to seek support.
practice: Treat crisis situations as requiring immediate local help.

name: Women's Health
overview: Explore preventive health information across life stages.
practice: Check local screening recommendations with professionals.

name: Men's Health
overview: Understand preventive checks and common wellbeing concerns.
practice: Use clinician guidance for individual symptoms.

name: Children's Health
overview: Review growth, activity and family health resources.
practice: Use age-specific pediatric sources for guidance.

name: Senior Wellness
overview: Explore mobility, nutrition and independence in later life.
practice: Assess falls and medication concerns with professionals.

name: Accessibility
overview: Understand inclusive design and common accommodation needs.
practice: Prefer tested accessibility standards and user feedback.

name: Home Safety
overview: Explore fall prevention, lighting and household hazards.
practice: Adapt measures to local building conditions and mobility needs.

name: Caregiving Basics
overview: Understand routine planning, support coordination and respite.
practice: Do not use general checklists to replace clinical care plans.

name: Public Health
overview: Learn population indicators and prevention programs.
practice: Check data coverage and national reporting differences.

name: Preventive Screening
overview: Understand screening goals, benefits and limitations.
practice: Seek age-appropriate recommendations from health authorities.

name: Medical Research
overview: Learn study designs, evidence quality and uncertainty.
practice: Distinguish observational association from causal findings.

name: Health Technology
overview: Explore telehealth, wearables and digital records.
practice: Check privacy, device validation and regulatory status.

name: Wellness Recipes
overview: Explore balanced meal planning and ingredient substitutions.
practice: Adapt for allergies and individual medical requirements.
